templates.narrative: Granted {days} days Furlough Leave for the cycle {cycle_from}-{cycle_to} from {leave_from} to {leave_to} with permission to prefix {prefix_first} & suffix {suffix_last}

slots.label: First prefix day
slots.help: A weekend or holiday joined to the front of the leave. Enter the first such day, or leave blank; the slip then prints Nil.

slots.label: First day of leave
slots.help: The first day of the leave itself, not counting any prefix.

slots.label: Last day of leave
slots.help: The last day of the leave itself, not counting any suffix.

slots.label: Last suffix day
slots.help: A weekend or holiday joined to the end of the leave. Enter the last such day, or leave blank; the slip then prints Nil.

slots.label: Days
slots.help: Counted for you from the first and last day of leave, both days included.

slots.label: First year of the furlough cycle
slots.help: The first calendar year of the three-year furlough cycle, for example 2024.

slots.label: Last year of the furlough cycle
slots.help: The last calendar year of the three-year furlough cycle, for example 2026.
